svg.aria-label: Poincare diagram: the type of equilibrium of a planar linear system depends on the trace and determinant of A. Below the trace axis (det A < 0) is a saddle; above it, inside the parabola (trace squared < 4 det) are foci, outside are nodes; the positive det axis gives centres; on the parabola are star or degenerate nodes; left half stable, right half unstable

g.text: det A = 0: a line of equilibria
